name: Apofeoz Degradatsii
source:
Fate was not kind to Yura, a simple hard worker and a bit of a dumbass. One day, he went in to buy some capitalist bullshit for his niece, but everything turned out to be not so simple...

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2585357966]Steam[/url]]
translation:
命运对尤拉并不友善，他是一个简单、勤奋、又有点傻的人。有一天，他进去给侄女买一些资本主义的狗屎，但事实证明一切并没有那么简单……

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2585357966]Steam[/url]]
